newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-FORTUNA DUESSELDORF SACK COACH RISTIC.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FORTUNA DUESSELDORF SACK COACH RISTIC.

text.p: Bundesliga strugglers Fortuna Duesseldorf sacked their coach Aleksander Ristic on Sunday, blaming a poor run of results which has brought them only two points from their last seven games.

The Bosnian coach had been at the club since 1992 and had a contract which ran until 1998. The final straw for Fortuna, who lie 15th in the first division, came with Friday's 2-0 defeat away to Karlsruhe.
